_comment: Second instance of the SAME A1<->A2 defect, in the D2 fan-in (not the pair
named in the work order, but covered by its target: >= 0.60 mm between ANY
POE_TAP_A1 and POE_TAP_A2 copper on the outer layers).
Before: via 17a75fde (0.6 @ 47.450,81.250) was 0.5500 mm from A2's B.Cu run
74189a96, and A1's B.Cu run d8da1bcb was 0.5826 mm from A2's corner 3c097738.
Fix: slide the via 0.300 mm SOUTH, away from A2's westward run, and re-lay its
two attached stubs. Via stays 0.6 mm - it does not need to shrink here, so it
keeps its 0.15 mm annular ring rather than dropping to the 0.10 mm minimum.
Kept east of D2 pad 1's east edge (x=47.42) so this does not become a
via-in-pad on a through-hole bridge-rectifier land.
